messages.subject: Using INLA, new beginner
parts:
Hi INLA users,


   I recently started to USE INLA and I get the following messages.
  
   Problem 1:
  
       *** WARNING *** Eigenvalue 2 of the Hessian is -0.0488702 < 0
    *** WARNING *** Set this eigenvalue to 0.65154
    *** WARNING *** This have consequence for the accurancy of
    *** WARNING *** the approximations; please check!!!
    *** WARNING *** R-inla: Use option inla(..., control.inla = list(h = h.value), ...)
    *** WARNING *** R-inla: to chose a different  `h.value'.
   
   
    Problem 2:
   
        GMRFLib version 3.0-0-snapshot, has recived error no [12]
    Reason    : The Newton-Raphson optimizer did not converge
    Message   : Condition `lambda < 1.0 / lambda_lim' is not TRUE
    Function  : GMRFLib_init_GMRF_approximation_store__intern
    File      : approx-inference.c
    Line      : 2694
    RCSId     : file: approx-inference.c  hgid: 15fa1e788b12  date: Fri Sep 20 09:14:11 2013 +0200

 Any help/explanations to avoid these messages will be approciated.

Thanks in advance


M. O

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Using INLA, new beginner
parts:
On Thu, 2014-06-05 at 03:51 -0700, ouabobaka wrote:
> Hi INLA users,

> ecently started to USE INLA and I get the following messages.
>
> Problem 1:

Hi, first problem is that the numerical negative Hessian is not positive
definite, and the second one is that the optimizer diverge.

These problems can be related and is usually due to a ill-defined model.
If you could send me (either to this list or to he...@r-inla.org), I can
have a closer look.

Best
H
